subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: For vLLM/local models that report token usage but have no nonzero configured price, should OpenClaw keep tokens-only plus missing-cost warnings, require explicit `models.providers.vllm.models[].cost`, or add another default pricing mechanism?
rationale: The current issue cannot be repaired safely until evidence proves whether the missing Usage-page data is a capture/persistence/UI bug or the expected no-local-price case, and pricing defaults for local models are a product contract.

options.title: Keep explicit pricing contract
options.body: Keep vLLM costs dependent on explicit local model pricing and improve docs or UI hints once the reporter provides boundary evidence.

options.title: Add a new pricing fallback
options.body: Define a default or configurable fallback for unpriced vLLM models, accepting the risk that local/free models need careful opt-out semantics.

options.title: Treat as duplicate of unknown-pricing work
options.body: If new evidence shows tokens are recorded and only cost is missing, route the remaining behavior to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit pricing contract
recommendation.body: Keep vLLM costs dependent on explicit local model pricing and improve docs or UI hints once the reporter provides boundary evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest sampled history across usage-cost reporting, vLLM streaming-usage compatibility, and the related unknown-pricing aggregation mitigation.
